easy.formula: empty lanes over all heats = lan ceil(ath / lan) - ath
buses for every rider = ceil(rid / bcp)
depots for those buses = ceil(ceil(rid / bcp) / dpt)
depots filled by full buses = (rid // bcp) // dpt
full buses outside full depots = (rid // bcp) mod dpt
empty seats on the last bus = bcp ceil(rid / bcp) - rid
lot area less a centre aisle of width stl = lotd (lotw - stl)
steps from the ground to floor flr = (flr - 1) stp
seats in the back row = fst + 2(rws - 1)
aisle seats, two a row, plus the front row = 2 rws + fst
rim panels of a stg x stg stage = 4 stg - 4
unit bars of a stg x stg floor grid = 2 stg (stg + 1)
seat blocks for every group = ceil(ceil(tix / grp) / blk)
blocks filled by full groups = (tix // grp) // blk
full groups outside full blocks = (tix // grp) mod blk

hard.formula: games in rds round-robin cycles of tm teams = rds tm(tm-1)/2
most points a team can take, 3 a win, rds cycles = 3 rds (tm - 1)
home and away fixtures, rds cycles = rds tm (tm - 1)
matchdays of a double round robin with tm teams, rds cycles = 2 rds (tm - 1)
three-team mini leagues from tm teams, rds sets = rds tm(tm-1)(tm-2)/6
handshakes between players of different teams = sqd^2 tm(tm-1)/2
handshakes among all tm sqd players = tm sqd (tm sqd - 1)/2
players on the bench, 11 on the field per team = tm (sqd - 11)
captain + vice-captain choices over all teams = tm sqd (sqd - 1)
margin of width lnw inside the court = cwd cln - (cwd - 2lnw)(cln - 2lnw)
court plus a run-off of lnw all round = (cwd + 2lnw)(cln + 2lnw)
lnw-square tiles to cover the court = (cwd // lnw)(cln // lnw)
posts every lnw round the court = 2 (cwd // lnw + cln // lnw)
centre cross of width lnw = lnw (cwd + cln - lnw)
heats to run every athlete in lan lanes = ceil(ath / lan)
heats over evn events = evn ceil(ath / lan)
podium orders over evn events of lan finalists = evn lan(lan-1)(lan-2)
seats when the first car is the engine = (ncar - 1) spr rpc
window seats, two a row, engine excluded = 2 rpc (ncar - 1)
seats off the windows, engine excluded = (spr - 2) rpc (ncar - 1)
seat pairs facing across the car = spr rpc (rpc - 1) ncar / 2
stalls of side stl in the lot = (lotw // stl)(lotd // stl)
lamps on every stl grid point = (lotw // stl + 1)(lotd // stl + 1)
ring road of width stl inside the lot = lotw lotd - (lotw - 2stl)(lotd - 2stl)
steps climbed visiting every floor from the ground in turn = stp flr(flr-1)/2
steps up and down to each floor and back = stp flr(flr-1)
rws rows, fst in front, 2 more each row = rws fst + rws(rws-1)
rws rows, fst in front, 1 more each row = rws fst + rws(rws-1)/2
lights in a square pyramid rig of stg tiers = stg(stg+1)(2stg+1)/6
truss nodes of a stg-cube rig = (stg + 1)^3
speakers in a triangular stack of stg rows on a base of stg+1 = (stg+1)(stg+2)/2
groups to seat every ticket holder = ceil(tix / grp)
seats in the full blocks = ((tix // grp) // blk) blk grp
